title: Rational Laguerre counterexamples to the harmonic-degree band for convex mosaics
description: Unrefereed mathematical candidate. Exact rational harmonic-degree counterexample 468/115, periodic weighted realization, interval (3,16), and regular-class asymptotic four-polytope comparison. Not a universal maximum, unweighted Voronoi counterexample or empirical fragmentation result. Supplied review actioned; internal finite exact replay and written analytic arguments, not external peer review, formal verification or independent reproduction. Shared evidence archive includes the companion manuscript. Original prose/data CC0-1.0; original code MIT.
